name: Nigina
text: Nigina the pool session moved to half six so text me when you get there, im grabbing the floats from the shed and the lane ropes are already out

name: Vijayabalan
text: Vijayabalan the coach leaves at seven sharp from the lay by by the church, bring a packed lunch and a rain coat because the forecast has showers all afternoon, we get back around six

name: Berta Castegnero
text: Berta Castegnero the parents evening slots are open and you can take either the five or the quarter past, the form teacher is in room nine and the science one is in the lab block, sign in at the main desk and grab the timetable sheet

name: Berghoff Högel
text: Berghoff Högel the tip run is booked for saturday morning so load the green waste tonight, the trailer is at ours and the gate code is on the fridge

name: Ricards
text: Ricards im on my way but the train is stuck outside the junction, hold the kick off till half past and put the nets up, i have the bibs and the pump for the balls

name: Menea
text: Menea the community hall booking went through for the 14th so we have the kitchen from noon, the key is with the caretaker and the tables fold flat in the store, remember the deposit receipt or they hold the bond, the urn is in the cupboard by the hatch and the mugs are labelled

name: Rawiya Gesine Mastantuono
text: Rawiya Gesine Mastantuono the motion goes to the vote at eight so reply on the thread before then, the wording is pinned

name: Annetta Lindtner
text: Annetta Lindtner the spare room is free from friday so your cousin can have it, the air bed is in the loft and i will leave the key under the pot, towels are in the airing cupboard

name: Sündüz
text: Sündüz the bike shop rang and the wheel is ready, they replaced the spoke and trued the rim for twenty, the lock is still there from the service and the receipt has your name on it, bring the old tube back for the recycling box, they close at six

name: Elsherbiny
text: Elsherbiny the choir practice is off tonight because the hall is being rewired, we will do the warm ups on the green instead if it stays dry

name: Ferifa Aishani Grebidela
text: Ferifa Aishani Grebidela the shift swap came through for thursday so you are on the late, the till float is counted and the key holder closes, i will bring the milk order sheet

name: Crispino Taltavull Grand-Clément
text: Crispino Taltavull Grand-Clément the match is moved to the back pitch because the sprinklers are on, kick off is still at two and the kit is in the away changing room, bring the water bottles and the half time oranges are sorted, the ref confirmed it on saturday morning

name: Kiflu
text: Kiflu your eye test is on friday at 4:20, the optician is the one in the precinct next to the bakery and they asked for your old glasses

name: Ohl
text: Ohl the surveyor comes on tuesday between nine and eleven, she needs access to the loft hatch and the fuse box, the report goes to the lender after that, clear the hallway before

name: Alojzije Nourou Cuquemel
text: Alojzije Nourou Cuquemel your physio starts on the 6th at ten past nine, the clinic is behind the leisure centre with parking round the back, wear trainers and bring the referral letter, each session runs about forty minutes, they always text a reminder the day before

name: Natthaphon Fikriye
text: Natthaphon Fikriye your table is booked for friday at 7:30 under your name, ask for the corner booth and the kitchen holds the cake

name: Lucas
text: Lucas your driving test is on the 21st at 11:40, meet the instructor at the test centre half an hour early and bring both parts of your licence, the car is booked for the morning

name: Sütterle
text: Sütterle your boiler service is on thursday afternoon, the engineer has the gate code and will ring before he sets off, keep the cupboard under the sink clear and the cat in, the landlord gets the invoice direct, the whole service usually takes about an hour

name: Adrian-Vasile Gebrekrstos
text: Adrian-Vasile Gebrekrstos your scan is on monday at 8:15, the imaging unit is the new building past the roundabout and you must fast from midnight

name: Fanonnel Leskiewicz
text: Fanonnel Leskiewicz your hygienist visit is on the 9th at 3:30, the practice is above the chemist and they asked you to bring your insurance details, park in the side street nearby

name: Xuseen
text: Xuseen your van goes for its inspection on wednesday at 8, the depot opens at half seven and you need the paperwork from the glovebox, they check the lights and the tyres so give it a wash first, the courtesy car needs booking by monday, no walk ins

name: Makai
text: Makai your hearing aid fitting is on tuesday at 10:45, the audiology desk is on the second floor and bring your appointment letter

name: Galéazzi Patoliya Lütenegger
text: Galéazzi Patoliya Lütenegger your viewing is on saturday at 11, the agent meets you outside the flat and the code for the car park is 4417, bring photo id, the lift is out so use the stairs

name: Marie-Huguette Fanchetti
text: Marie-Huguette Fanchetti your tax appointment is on the 3rd at 9:30, the office is the one by the station and you need last year's return plus the rent statements, they do a drop in on fridays if you miss it, ring ahead if you are running late

name: Renilda
text: the coach is full now so we are taking two cars instead, Renilda is driving the second one so meet at the lay by at half six, bring the flags

name: Nezirevic
text: the session is moving to the back room because the front one is booked, Nezirevic has the key so she opens up at seven, bring a mat if you have one

name: Mowlid Buzgheiba
text: the garden share is on saturday from ten, bring any spare pots and the seed packets you never used, Mowlid Buzgheiba is doing the tea and cake stall so drop your bakes off friday night, the shed is open for tools and the gate stays unlocked until two

name: Urhan Zinep
text: the back room is sorted for tonight, Urhan Zinep is bringing the projector and the speakers are already there, doors open at seven

name: Niara
text: the rota is up for the summer fair and the tombola still needs two names, Niara can do the morning shift and i will cover the afternoon, sign the sheet on the fridge door

name: Gyaltag
text: the appeal is going well and we are past half of the target, Gyaltag is matching anything donated this weekend so dig deep, the page is pinned in the group and the receipts are posted weekly, thanks to everyone who has given so far, every pound counts

name: Santhiny Stausberg
text: the picnic is still on unless the storm warning holds, Santhiny Stausberg has the gazebo so we can shelter if it turns, bring a chair

name: Heavenly Slameczka
text: the forms are ready for the trip and the payment link goes live friday, Heavenly Slameczka is collecting the consent slips so hand them in by wednesday, the coach leaves at eight

name: Catalin-Marian
text: the tools are back from the sharpeners and the bill is in the tin, Catalin-Marian is picking up the timber friday so the bench build starts saturday, we still need screws and a second clamp, i will bring the drill bits, measure the cuts twice as usual

name: Cristofaro
text: the boiler man came and the pressure is fine now, Cristofaro has the receipt for the landlord, keep the radiator on

name: Arokium Konareff Sonko
text: the window cleaner is switching to fridays so leave the gate unlatched, Arokium Konareff Sonko is paying him for both houses and i will settle up at the weekend, the dog stays in

name: de Joffrey
text: the harvest supper list is nearly full and the hall is booked, de Joffrey is doing the main and we need two more puddings plus bread, the raffle prizes are wrapped and the tickets are printed, set up starts at four, bring your own crockery again this year

name: Castorina
text: the keys are under the blue pot by the side gate, Castorina let the plumber in this morning so the leak is fixed, bins go out tonight

name: Samuella
text: just to confirm your dental check is on the 12th at 9:20, Samuella will meet you at the desk and take the paperwork, the practice texts if anything changes, come a little early

name: Mihill
text: this is a reminder that your induction is on monday at 8:30 in the training room, Mihill from the front desk will sign you in and hand over the lanyard, bring your bank details and photo id, the session runs till noon with a break, no need to print anything

name: Elard Melino
text: quick reminder that the chimney sweep comes friday at 8, Elard Melino will move the furniture so the hearth is clear, no fires that morning

name: de Maria
text: just a note that the meter reading visit is tuesday between one and three, de Maria has the key box code and will let the reader in, the dog is staying at my mums

name: Kristiyan
text: reminder that your shift briefing is on wednesday at 6:45 before the doors open, Kristiyan from the day team is running it and the safety updates are on the board, sign the sheet and grab the new lanyard, coffee is on the house, we finish by seven

name: Barmes
text: friendly reminder the cat sitter comes friday evening, Barmes has the feeding notes and the spare key is back in the drawer, bowls are labelled

name: Heavenly Dézsi
text: quick reminder that the flat viewing is on saturday at 10:30, Heavenly Dézsi is meeting the agent and will send photos after, the entry code is in the group chat, park on the main road

name: Pikulin Kurtish
text: this is a reminder that the boiler inspection is thursday from nine, Pikulin Kurtish will be on site all morning and the engineer signs in at the hut, keep the plant room clear and the log book out, the certificate follows by email within a week

name: Xhihan
text: reminder that the fitter comes monday at 1, Xhihan will be home all afternoon and the parts are already in the garage, no need to move the car

name: Andreoni
text: just a reminder that the choir photos are on the 20th at 7, Andreoni has the robes and the music folders, wear the black shoes and arrive before the warm up

name: Anne-Käthi Graber-Bögli
text: this is a reminder that the passport appointment is on the 7th at 8:50, Anne-Käthi Graber-Bögli has the forms and the photos are in the folder, bring the old passport and the fee in cash, the office holds the queue numbers, get there before the doors open

name: van Zijl
text: quick reminder that the gala set up starts at nine, van Zijl is bringing the banners and the prize table, sign in at the side door

name: Takaki
text: just a reminder that the car service is booked for tuesday at 8:30, Takaki will leave the keys with them the evening before and collect the courtesy car, the garage rings when it is ready
